registryBasis: The Rivers State Office of the Surveyor General is evidenced by its SGRIV land-management portal, which identifies the Office of the Surveyor General, Rivers State, and provides land-management account/request entry points. This establishes a relevant state land custodian, not an open parcel geometry API. The federal OSGOF cadastral page was retained only as general national agency context.

requests.outcome: Public landing page fetched. It identifies the Office of the Surveyor General, Rivers State, and exposes Start Your Request/Access Account links resolving to /register and /login. No public map, API, feature schema, CRS, or parcel geometry was exposed. No account or login was attempted.
Official Rivers State portal returned HTTP 403. No challenge bypass or alternate authenticated route was attempted.
Official Rivers State Ministry of Physical Planning and Urban Development portal was identified in search results; no parcel endpoint or geometry response was verified in this bounded attempt.
Federal OSGOF page describes nationwide cadastral/legal survey functions and a cadastral GIS role. It is general national agency prose, not Okrika- or Rivers-scoped open parcel data.
